key.name: group-with-previous
key.summary: Group focused window with the last used one

key.name: saved-button-layout
key.summary: Window button layout saved while groups exist

key.name: rules
key.description: Each entry is a comma-separated list of window classes (wm_class or app id) that are grouped automatically, e.g. "org.gnome.Calendar, org.gnome.Evolution".

key.name: saved-groups
key.description: Each entry is a comma-separated list of window classes. Opening one of them also opens the others and groups them.

key.name: pinned
key.description: Window classes (wm_class or app id) whose tabs are pinned: icon only, always first.

key.name: compact
key.description: The side bar shows icons only and opens over the window while hovered.

key.name: sidebar-width
key.description: Narrow shows icons only, medium icon and title, wide shows a live preview.

key.name: top-preview
key.summary: Permanent previews above the top bar

key.name: preview-width
key.summary: Width of the previews above the top bar
